title: Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Mock Exam #19

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #19
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which surah is the last surah of the Qur'an? (1 mark)
   A. Al-Fatiha
   B. Al-Ikhlas
   C. Al-Falaq
   D. An-Naas

2. What do we ask Allah for in the sixth verse of Al-Fatiha? (1 mark)
   A. To make us famous
   B. To give us money
   C. To make us win games
   D. To guide us to the straight path

3. Which surah is number 110 in the Qur'an? (1 mark)
   A. Al-Ikhlas
   B. Al-Kafirun
   C. An-Nasr
   D. Al-Masad

4. What does "Al-Amin" mean? (1 mark)
   A. The strong
   B. The tall
   C. The trustworthy
   D. The rich

5. Who is the best example of good character for Muslims? (1 mark)
   A. Prophet Muhammad (S.A.W.)
   B. A rich businessman
   C. A game character
   D. A film star

6. Which is an example of copying the Prophet's kindness? (1 mark)
   A. Hiding a friend's book
   B. Sharing your lunch with a classmate
   C. Teasing a friend
   D. Refusing to greet people

7. Which of these follows the Sunnah of eating? (1 mark)
   A. Sit calmly, say Bismillah and eat with the right hand
   B. Criticise the food
   C. Use the left hand for pleasure
   D. Eat while running

8. In the Prophet's teaching, before every prayer the siwak was (1 mark)
   A. Strongly encouraged but not made compulsory
   B. Required only for sick people
   C. Forbidden
   D. Compulsory on children only

9. What should a boy cover at least while playing sports? (1 mark)
   A. From the navel to the knees
   B. Nothing
   C. Only the hands
   D. Only the head

10. What does "As-Sami'" mean? (1 mark)
   A. The All-Hearing
   B. The Most Kind
   C. The All-Seeing
   D. The King

11. Which attribute means Allah is free from all faults? (1 mark)
   A. Al-Malik
   B. Al-Basir
   C. As-Salam
   D. Ar-Rahim

12. What are angels created from? (1 mark)
   A. Water
   B. Fire
   C. Clay
   D. Light

13. Which is a wrong belief about angels? (1 mark)
   A. That they are made of light
   B. That they obey Allah
   C. That they carry out duties
   D. That they are Allah's daughters

14. Prophet Nuh called his people to Allah for how long? (1 mark)
   A. 50 years
   B. 950 years
   C. 100 days
   D. 9 years

15. What is patience? (1 mark)
   A. Staying calm and trusting Allah in hardship
   B. Getting angry
   C. Complaining
   D. Giving up

16. What is the meaning of generosity? (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to share
   B. Giving freely without expecting anything back
   C. Boasting
   D. Keeping everything

17. If there is solid matter of a najasa, what should you do first? (1 mark)
   A. Remove it
   B. Ignore it
   C. Cover it
   D. Sprinkle perfume

18. Why is wudhu important? (1 mark)
   A. It is needed for the prayer to be valid
   B. It is a game
   C. It replaces prayer
   D. It makes prayer shorter

19. Why must clothes and the prayer place be clean? (1 mark)
   A. It saves money
   B. It is a game
   C. It is not needed
   D. Purity is a condition of prayer

20. What must a boy cover at the least during prayer? (1 mark)
   A. Nothing
   B. Only the face
   C. From navel to knees
   D. Only the feet

21. Kindness to animals is (1 mark)
   A. Only for farmers
   B. An act of worship when done for Allah
   C. Forbidden
   D. A waste

22. What does the Qur'an (7:26) say is the best clothing? (1 mark)
   A. The newest
   B. The clothing of righteousness
   C. The brightest
   D. The most expensive

23. What is assertiveness in dressing? (1 mark)
   A. Copying everyone
   B. Politely standing by how you dress because of faith
   C. Shouting
   D. Insulting others

24. Which of these is a mobile phone use that follows Islamic manners? (1 mark)
   A. Calling a relative to greet them
   B. Sending unkind messages
   C. Playing during prayer
   D. Sharing private photos

25. Which of these is a skill that can bring honest income later? (1 mark)
   A. Tailoring
   B. Stealing
   C. Cheating
   D. Lying

26. What does Qur'an 62:10 tell us after prayer? (1 mark)
   A. Stay at home
   B. Beg
   C. Stop working
   D. Spread through the land and seek Allah's bounty

27. What do we say when leaving the house? (1 mark)
   A. Amin only
   B. Bismillah, tawakkaltu 'alallah, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah
   C. Alhamdulillah only
   D. Bismillahi walajna

28. Why are parents to be respected? (1 mark)
   A. They are old only
   B. They are rich
   C. They are tall
   D. They sacrifice time, energy and money for us

29. What does "'Alaq" refer to in Surah Al-Alaq? (1 mark)
   A. A mountain
   B. A cave
   C. A clinging clot
   D. A pen

30. Which angel brought the first revelation? (1 mark)
   A. Israfil
   B. Jibril
   C. Raqib
   D. Mikail

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Explain why we say Bismillah before eating. (3 marks)

32. Choose one early convert and explain a lesson children can learn from that person. (4 marks)

33. Explain tartib in swalah. (2 marks)

34. Define wudhu and state its intention. (2 marks)

35. Give three manners of making dua. (3 marks)

36. Describe what you should do when you enter your home. (4 marks)

37. Write the seven surahs studied in this lesson and give the number of verses in any three of them. (5 marks)

38. Describe how to find the Qibla using the sun in Kenya. (3 marks)

39. Why was the Prophet (S.A.W.) called Al-Amin? (3 marks)

40. Explain tawakkul using an example. (3 marks)

41. What does it mean that children are an amanah? (2 marks)

42. State three things that nullify wudhu. (3 marks)

43. How did Khadija (R.A.) comfort the Prophet (S.A.W.)? (3 marks)

44. State three values learned from participating in sports. (3 marks)

45. What happened to the woman who did not feed her cat? (3 marks)

46. State two lessons a child can learn from the Prophet's youth. (2 marks)

47. Name two dressing trends a Muslim should avoid. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #19 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — An-Naas
   An-Naas is number 114, the last surah.

2. D — To guide us to the straight path
   The verse is "Guide us to the straight path".

3. C — An-Nasr
   An-Nasr is 110, Al-Masad 111 and Al-Kafirun 109.

4. C — The trustworthy
   The people of Makkah called Muhammad Al-Amin.

5. A — Prophet Muhammad (S.A.W.)
   The Qur'an praises his great character.

6. B — Sharing your lunch with a classmate
   Kindness means caring for others.

7. A — Sit calmly, say Bismillah and eat with the right hand
   These are Sunnah manners.

8. A — Strongly encouraged but not made compulsory
   He said he would have ordered it if not hard.

9. A — From the navel to the knees
   This is the minimum covering.

10. A — The All-Hearing
   As-Sami' hears everything.

11. C — As-Salam
   As-Salam means He is perfect and free of faults.

12. D — Light
   The Prophet said angels were created from light.

13. D — That they are Allah's daughters
   Islam rejects this.

14. B — 950 years
   Qur'an 29:14 mentions 950 years.

15. A — Staying calm and trusting Allah in hardship
   Patience is steady calm.

16. B — Giving freely without expecting anything back
   Generous people give willingly.

17. A — Remove it
   Remove the substance first.

18. A — It is needed for the prayer to be valid
   Prayer is not accepted without it.

19. D — Purity is a condition of prayer
   A valid prayer needs purity.

20. C — From navel to knees
   This is the minimum.

21. B — An act of worship when done for Allah
   Mercy pleases Allah.

22. B — The clothing of righteousness
   Good character is best.

23. B — Politely standing by how you dress because of faith
   You calmly explain.

24. A — Calling a relative to greet them
   Keeping ties is good.

25. A — Tailoring
   Tailoring is a skill.

26. D — Spread through the land and seek Allah's bounty
   Work and pray.

27. B — Bismillah, tawakkaltu 'alallah, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah
   This is the dua for leaving.

28. D — They sacrifice time, energy and money for us
   Gratitude.

29. C — A clinging clot
   Man was created from a clinging clot.

30. B — Jibril
   Jibril brings revelation.

SECTION B
----
31. (3 marks)
   Answer: We ask for Allah's blessing and remember that food is from Him. It makes eating an act of worship.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid reason.

32. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example, Ali teaches that a young person can be brave and truthful for Allah.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the person, 1 mark for a fact, 1 mark for a lesson, 1 mark for clear explanation.

33. (2 marks)
   Answer: Doing the pillars in the correct order.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for order and 1 mark for an example.

34. (2 marks)
   Answer: Wudhu is washing certain parts of the body with water to prepare for prayer. The intention is made in the heart.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for definition and 1 mark for intention.

35. (3 marks)
   Answer: Begin with praise, face the Qibla and raise hands, be humble, be patient, say Amin.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

36. (4 marks)
   Answer: Say Bismillah and the dua, greet with salaam, place shoes neatly, wash hands, speak kindly.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of four actions.

37. (5 marks)
   Answer: Al-Fatiha (7), Al-Kafirun (6), An-Nasr (3), Al-Masad (5), Al-Ikhlas (4), Al-Falaq (5), An-Naas (6). Any three with correct number of verses.
   Working / marking points: 4 marks for naming all seven (award proportionally), 1 mark for three correct verse counts.

38. (3 marks)
   Answer: Stretch the right arm towards the sunrise, which is east, and face forward, which is roughly north. Confirm with a compass or mosque.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the right arm to east, 1 mark for facing north, 1 mark for checking.

39. (3 marks)
   Answer: People trusted him with their valuables because he was honest and returned them.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for honest, 1 mark for trust, 1 mark for keeping trust.

40. (3 marks)
   Answer: Tawakkul is doing our part and then trusting Allah, for example taking an umbrella and saying the dua before leaving.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for meaning, 1 mark for example, 1 mark for trust in Allah.

41. (2 marks)
   Answer: A trust from Allah that parents must look after.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for trust and 1 mark for parents' care.

42. (3 marks)
   Answer: Urine, stool or wind; deep sleep lying down; fainting.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: She covered him with a blanket, reminded him of his good character and said Allah would not disgrace him, and took him to Waraqa.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

44. (3 marks)
   Answer: Teamwork, sharing, humility, fair play, discipline, leadership.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each value.

45. (3 marks)
   Answer: She tied the cat and did not feed it or let it find food. She was punished because of this. It teaches us that cruelty to animals is a sin.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the action, 1 mark for the punishment, 1 mark for the lesson.

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: Honest work is honourable, and a person can be good even if poor or an orphan.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each lesson.

47. (2 marks)
   Answer: Tight or see-through clothes, and clothes with rude words or pictures.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.
